dossier.headline: Vomero Plus SP Cheat Day
dossier.summary: The Nike Vomero Plus SP "Cheat Day" (style IV4522-200) is a performance running sneaker in a Desert Camo/Yukon Brown/Ceramic colorway, built on a full-length ZoomX foam midsole with an engineered mesh upper. Part of Nike's Special Projects (SP) range, it pairs a neutral khaki upper with an orange gradient through the forefoot inspired by cheesy snack dust, retailing at $175.

facts.label: Material
facts.value: Engineered mesh upper with full-length ZoomX foam midsole, high-abrasion rubber outsole

story.title: A "Cheat Day" color story
story.detail: Nike's narrative treats the neutral tan/khaki upper with a bright orange gradient through the forefoot and midsole, visually referencing cheesy snack dust after an indulgent cheat day.

story.title: Special Projects designation
story.detail: The shoe carries Nike's "SP" label, situating it within the Special Projects range reserved for more experimental, story-driven releases rather than the standard Vomero Plus inline offering.

story.title: ZoomX cushioning platform
story.detail: The Vomero Plus midsole uses a mountainous stack of ZoomX foam with 4 mm more height than the Invincible 3, for a softer, lighter and more responsive ride than the Vomero 18.

references.title: Vomero Plus running line
references.detail: The shoe belongs to Nike's Vomero Plus running family, described with a 10 mm heel-to-toe drop and roughly 292 g weight for a men's US 10.

references.title: Cheetos-dust palette
references.detail: Hypebeast and House of Heat editorial coverage describe the khaki upper with an orange fade inspired by cheesy snack residue, plus orange pull tab and lace tips.

styling: Let the neutral khaki upper anchor an earth-toned casual outfit
Play up the orange gradient with warm-tone accessories
Pair with tapered trousers or cropped joggers to show the ZoomX stack
Keep branding minimal by styling with clean, tonal separates

pairWith.label: Tapered trousers

pairWith.label: Crew socks
pairWith.reason: A cushioned crew sock complements the running silhouette and warm palette.

pairWith.label: Windbreaker jacket
pairWith.reason: A lightweight technical shell matches the performance running context of the sneaker.

dossier.lookbookPrompt: A single editorial lookbook sheet in one 3:2 landscape image, arranged as a strict 2x2 grid (2 rows x 2 columns) of four equal landscape cells with uniform hairline gutters, grid flush to all four edges, no outer margin. Cell 1 (top-left): close crop of the Nike Vomero Plus SP Cheat Day sneaker on concrete showing the orange forefoot gradient. Cell 2 (top-right): full-body shot of a person walking, sneakers visible, wearing khaki tapered trousers. Cell 3 (bottom-left): side-angle of both sneakers together on gravel. Cell 4 (bottom-right): seated pose with sneakers crossed, warm daylight. Each cell fills about two thirds with the product, varied pose and angle, all sharing warm natural daylight and soft neutral film grain. No text, captions, numbers, watermarks, rounded corners or drop shadows.
